page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to handle inter-instance communication and external traffic. No integrated GPUs are present on this server type, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a balanced general-purpose resource. The dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.1 GHz offer predictable compute performance for workloads such as web serving, application servers, build systems, and medium-sized database deployments that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
